meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 WhatsApp 与用户聊天。它用二维码或配对码绑定手机号，直连 WhatsApp Web。若用共享号码，它只回你自己的“自聊”消息；用专用号码则所有消息都发给它。
howto.when: 当用户要求给 Claude 添加或接入 WhatsApp 频道时触发，比如说出“添加 WhatsApp”、“接入 WhatsApp”等指令。

say.text: 用二维码连接我的 WhatsApp
用配对码连接我的 WhatsApp

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can chat with you over WhatsApp. It links a phone by QR scan or pairing code, connecting directly to WhatsApp Web. On a shared number it replies only in your self-chat; on a dedicated number all messages to that number reach it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to add or connect a WhatsApp channel, e.g., saying 'add WhatsApp' or 'connect WhatsApp'.

say_en.text: Link my WhatsApp with a QR code
Link my WhatsApp with a pairing code
